name: Teleport Obby! (OBBY BUT YOU CAN TELEPORT)
desc:
NOTE: THIS IS A HARD GAME

--CONTROLS--

-Press E on PC 

-Press L2 or Button X in console    
                          
-Press the purple button on mobile

There is data saving

Go through obstacles by teleportation: this way, passing through tough courses, walls or fences would not become a problem anymore for you. Every level contains different items which check your flexibility as well as the ability to transfer with the use of teleport. 💥Teleportation Mechanics 💥Challenging Parkour Levels DISCLAIMER Unfortunately this obby does not contain boring gameplay, also way better than those "Easy Obby" or "Super Fun Obby" games
